description: vite-plus. vite-plus, its core and the vite npm: alias move as one PR. Guard: each repo fails CI when the lockfile holds more than one core version. Extend after default.

packageRules.description: vite-plus and its core are a Lockstep set. The core is numbered after the Vite it bundles, so a vite-plus minor comes with a core major. One PR for every update type, with one 7-day cooldown. A PR holding a major is merged by hand, because Renovate auto-merges a group only when every update in it qualifies. Renovate's npm manager reads the vite: npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@<version> alias in pnpm-workspace.yaml with the core as its package name, so this rule takes the alias too.
